description: This file defines a custom exception class WebServiceException used for handling web service errors in the vtiger CRM system. It references an external error code file and provides constructor initialization for error code and message.

classes.name: WebServiceException
classes.description: A custom exception class for web service error handling, extending PHP's base Exception class. It contains properties for error code and message, and a constructor to initialize these properties.

methods.name: WebServiceException
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes the WebServiceException with an error code and message.
